articles.title: Speeding Container Truck Loses Control at Karnataka Toll Plaza, Crashes Into Car and Toll Booth
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Karnataka)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A speeding container truck allegedly lost control and crashed into a car and toll booth in Davanagere, Karnataka. CCTV footage shows the truck veering into the toll area at high speed, with several people reportedly injured and a car occupant narrowly escaping serious harm.

body.html:
A major accident was reported at a toll plaza in Davanagere district, Karnataka, after a speeding container truck allegedly lost control and crashed into a car and the toll booth.

CCTV footage of the incident has surfaced online, showing the container truck approaching the toll lane at high speed before appearing to veer out of control.

The truck reportedly slammed into a car parked near the toll area and also struck people and infrastructure around the booth. Several people were injured in the collision, while those inside the car reportedly escaped with injuries.

The footage also appears to show people standing near the car moments before the truck approaches, highlighting how narrowly some bystanders may have escaped being hit.

The exact number and condition of those injured, as well as whether anyone was killed, have not been independently confirmed from the information provided.

Authorities are expected to investigate the cause of the truck losing control and examine the CCTV footage as part of the inquiry.

articles.title: Dashcam Footage Shows Atiq Ahmed’s Son Abaan’s Car Veering Into Divider Before Fatal Crash
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: Abaan Ahmed
articles.excerpt: A speeding container truck allegedly lost control and crashed into a car and toll booth in Karnataka’s Davanagere district. CCTV footage shows the truck approaching at high speed before the collision, with several people reportedly injured. Authorities are investigating the cause of the crash.

body.html:
Dashcam footage of the fatal road accident involving Abaan Ahmed, son of gangster Atiq Ahmed, has surfaced, capturing the moments before the crash in Jhansi.

The accident took place on August 6, when the car carrying Abaan and four others reportedly lost control. The footage shows the vehicle suddenly swerving to the left, striking a road divider and becoming airborne before crashing.

Abaan Ahmed and one of his friends died in the accident, while three other occupants sustained injuries.

The newly surfaced video shows the vehicle's final moments before the collision and is being examined as part of the investigation.

Police are analysing the dashcam footage and other evidence to determine the exact circumstances that caused the vehicle to lose control.

articles.title: Drunk IT Professional Allegedly Fires Air Gun at Security Guards, Cars for 45 Minutes
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Karnataka)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: The accused, identified as Anurag Tiwari
articles.excerpt: A 40-year-old IT professional was arrested in Bengaluru after allegedly firing an air gun from his apartment balcony at security guards, parked vehicles and a parking shed. Police said the firing continued for nearly 45 minutes, causing panic among residents. No injuries were reported.

body.html:
A 40-year-old IT professional was arrested after allegedly firing an air gun from the balcony of his apartment at security guards, parked vehicles and a parking shed in Anekal taluk on the outskirts of Bengaluru.

The accused, identified as Anurag Tiwari, a native of Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, works for a private company in Whitefield and had been living in Flat B304 of the Bliss-1 block at Sipani Apartments near Bandapura for the past eight months.

According to police, the incident occurred at around 2:30 am, when Tiwari allegedly consumed alcohol and was heard shouting while talking on the phone. He then allegedly stepped onto his balcony and began firing an air gun.

Police said the accused continued firing for nearly 45 minutes, triggering panic among residents of the apartment complex.

The air gun pellets allegedly struck several parked vehicles and the parking shed. Security guards who responded to the commotion were also reportedly targeted, though no injuries were reported.

A resident whose car window was shattered in the incident said he did not know the accused personally and believed the firing may have occurred while he was intoxicated.

Following a complaint, police reached the apartment complex and took the accused into custody.

The Scene of Crime Operations (SOCO) team inspected the spot and recovered air gun pellets from near the damaged vehicles. Police also seized the air gun and the pellets allegedly used in the incident.

A case has been registered at Suryanagar Police Station, and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Road Accident or Deliberate Murder? Family Alleges Youth Was Rammed After Argument in Kerala
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Kerala)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: The victim, identified as Rijas
articles.excerpt: A Kerala family has alleged that a road crash in Thrissur’s Pudukkad that killed a youth named Rijas was deliberate. They claim an argument occurred minutes before the collision and that the other vehicle intentionally rammed his motorcycle. Police are examining CCTV and dashcam footage.

body.html:
The family of a youth who died in a road accident in Kerala's Thrissur district has alleged that the crash was a deliberate act rather than an accident.

The victim, identified as Rijas, a native of Pattambi, died on Sunday evening after the motorcycle he was travelling on was involved in a collision in Pudukkad.

According to his family, Rijas and a friend had an argument with the occupants of the vehicle involved in the crash around 10 minutes before the collision.

Rijas' father alleged that the occupants of the vehicle, who are reportedly from Tamil Nadu, intentionally rammed the motorcycle following the altercation. The family has submitted a complaint to the Thrissur Rural Superintendent of Police, seeking a detailed investigation into the incident.

A woman who was travelling with Rijas reportedly informed the family about the argument that took place before the crash. His father also claimed that police found the occupants of the vehicle to be under the influence of alcohol at the time of the incident.

Dashcam footage and CCTV visuals of the collision have surfaced, and police are examining the footage as part of the investigation.

Authorities have not confirmed the family's allegations, and the exact cause of the crash is yet to be established. Police said further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Class 10 Student Collapses While Playing Volleyball, Dies Suddenly in Karnataka
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Karnataka)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: The deceased has been identified as Likhith Ameen
articles.excerpt: A 15-year-old Class 10 student died after suddenly collapsing while playing volleyball with friends near Surathkal in Karnataka’s Mangaluru. Likhith Ameen was rushed to a nearby hospital but was declared dead. The exact cause of his sudden collapse has not yet been confirmed.

body.html:
A 15-year-old Class 10 student died after suddenly collapsing while playing volleyball with friends near Surathkal in Karnataka's Mangaluru on Wednesday.

The deceased has been identified as Likhith Ameen, son of autorickshaw driver Madhav Ameen. He was a Class 10 student at Government High School, Kote Bollaru, Soorinje.

According to reports, Likhith was playing volleyball with friends at a playground in Soorinje when he suddenly collapsed. He was immediately rushed to a nearby hospital, where doctors declared him dead despite efforts to revive him.

The exact cause of his sudden collapse has not yet been officially confirmed.

Likhith is survived by his parents and two sisters. His unexpected death has left his family, classmates and the local community in shock and mourning.

articles.title: Kerala YouTuber Akhil NRD’s Wife Reportedly Leaves Home With Bus Driver; Missing Complaint Filed
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Kerala)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: Husband Akhil NRD, wife Megha and bus driver
articles.excerpt: Malayalam YouTuber and actor Akhil NRD has reportedly drawn attention after his wife, Megha, allegedly left their home with a local bus driver. Police are examining CCTV footage and investigating the circumstances surrounding her departure and the claims circulating online.

body.html:
Malayalam YouTuber and actor Akhil NRD has reportedly become the centre of attention after his wife, Megha, allegedly left their home with a local bus driver.

According to reports circulating online, Megha allegedly left during the night carrying luggage, cash and jewellery. The matter reportedly came to light after Akhil filed a missing-person complaint, following which police examined CCTV footage to trace her movements.

The circumstances surrounding her disappearance and the nature of her relationship with the bus driver have not been independently established, and the allegations remain under investigation.

Akhil's close friend and former Bigg Boss contestant Sai Krishna also spoke about the development on his YouTube channel. He reportedly said the news came as a shock to him because he had attended Akhil and Megha's wedding and had maintained a close friendship with Akhil since 2021.

Akhil, from Alappuzha, is a prominent Malayalam digital creator and actor known for comedy, family-oriented and relatable content. He began creating online content around 2015 and later expanded his presence on YouTube and Instagram.

He has also moved into Malayalam cinema, appearing in films including Maharaja Hostel and Ashakal Aayiram in 2026.

Akhil and Megha reportedly married in November 2024, after knowing each other for several years.

Police are expected to establish the circumstances surrounding Megha's departure and verify the claims circulating about the incident.

articles.title: Chhattisgarh Collector Accused of Forcing Man to Clean Toilet
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Chhattisgarh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Former cooperative society manager Shashikant Mahant has alleged that Sakti Collector Amrit Vikas Topno ordered him to clean a toilet during a paddy procurement meeting. Mahant approached the Human Rights Commission, seeking a probe. Video footage purportedly showing the incident has surfaced.

body.html:
A serious allegation has emerged from Chhattisgarh's Sakti district, where former Putidih Seva Cooperative Society manager Shashikant Mahant has alleged that he was forced to clean a toilet inside the Collectorate during a paddy procurement meeting.

According to Mahant's complaint to the Chhattisgarh Human Rights Commission, the incident allegedly occurred on April 29, 2026, at around 12:40 pm, when a meeting of officials and cooperative society managers was underway at the Sakti Collectorate.

Mahant has directly alleged that District Collector Amrit Vikas Topno ordered him to clean the toilet. He claims that despite protesting, he was made to carry out the cleaning and was allegedly not provided with basic cleaning equipment such as a brush or toilet cleaner.

Mahant has also submitted or circulated video footage purportedly showing him cleaning the toilet. He further alleged that Additional Collector Baleshwar Ram photographed and recorded the incident and that other officials were present at the Collectorate at the time.

The complaint names several officials who were allegedly present during the meeting, including District Food Officer Khumeshwar Singh, Assistant Food Officer Kamal Agarwal, District Marketing Officer Shobhana Tiwari and District Cooperative Bank Nodal Officer Ashwini Pandey.

The allegations have emerged against the backdrop of an earlier dispute involving the Putidih cooperative society. A complaint had reportedly been received regarding alleged mixing of stones and soil with paddy during procurement. Following an inquiry, police registered an FIR against Mahant, procurement in-charge Prakash Mahant and others. Mahant and Prakash were subsequently arrested, according to the complaint.

Mahant has now approached the Human Rights Commission seeking an impartial investigation and action against those responsible.

The matter has also triggered a political response. Bhilai MLA Devendra Yadav criticised the alleged treatment and demanded an independent inquiry, describing the incident as a serious issue concerning dignity and human rights.

However, the allegations against the Collector and other officials have not yet been established by an official inquiry. The Human Rights Commission and authorities are expected to examine the complaint, available video evidence and statements of those present before determining what actually occurred.

If the allegations are substantiated, the incident could raise serious questions about official conduct, workplace dignity and the treatment of individuals inside government premises.

articles.title: Masked Man Breaks Into Telangana Temple, Walks Away With ₹20,000 Donation Box in CCTV-Caught Theft
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Telangana)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A masked man allegedly broke into a temple in Sadashivpet, Telangana, and fled with a donation box containing around ₹20,000. CCTV footage captured the suspected theft, and police have registered a case while working to identify and arrest the accused.

body.html:
A masked man allegedly broke into a temple in Gurunagar Colony, Sadashivpet, Sangareddy district, and fled with the donation box (hundi) in the early hours of Saturday, August 8.

The incident took place at Sri Bhavani Mata Temple and was captured on CCTV. The footage reportedly shows a man dressed in dark clothes forcing open the temple door before casually walking away with the hundi.

Speaking about the incident, Sadashivpet Police said a case has been registered and CCTV footage is being examined to identify the suspect.

A police officer said the donation box did not contain a large amount of money and was estimated to have around ₹20,000.

Police are continuing their investigation to trace and apprehend the accused.

articles.title: Woman Run Over by Scorpio During Udaipur Clash: 20–25 Men Allegedly Attack House
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Rajasthan)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: The deceased has been identified as Urmila Kanwar
articles.excerpt: A 52-year-old woman was allegedly run over by a Scorpio and killed during a violent clash in Udaipur, Rajasthan. Police said a dispute between two groups escalated into an attack at her son’s house, where vehicles were damaged. A murder case has been registered.

body.html:
A 52-year-old woman was allegedly run over by a Scorpio and killed during a violent clash in Udaipur, Rajasthan, after a dispute involving her son and another group escalated on Friday evening.

The deceased has been identified as Urmila Kanwar, wife of Fatah Singh. The incident took place at around 5:43 pm in Kapil Vihar Colony on Airport Road, under the jurisdiction of Pratap Nagar Police Station.

According to police, a dispute was already ongoing between Yash Pratap Singh, a resident of Nandsa in Bhilwara, and Yashpal Singh Jhala, a resident of Meenada in Chittorgarh. The two groups reportedly clashed on Friday afternoon, with Urmila's son Divyaraj Singh present during the altercation.

Police said that later in the evening, Yashpal Singh allegedly arrived at Divyaraj's house with a group of around 10–15 men in three SUVs, including a Scorpio and two Thar vehicles.

The group allegedly began pelting stones at vehicles parked outside the house, damaging two cars. Hearing the commotion, Urmila came out of the house.

As she reportedly tried to flee and stop the attackers, the accused allegedly drove the Scorpio over her, causing critical injuries.

Urmila was rushed to a nearby private hospital, where doctors declared her dead.

A video of the incident has surfaced, and police are examining the footage to identify those involved. Police have registered a murder case and launched a search for the accused.

Meanwhile, the victim's family has refused to take the body, demanding that all those responsible be arrested.

BJP Rajsamand district member Vishwanath Pratap Singh reached Udaipur and alleged that around 20–25 people attacked the house and damaged vehicles. He demanded the arrest of all accused and action against their properties.

The investigation is underway, and police are searching for the suspects based on CCTV and video evidence.

articles.title: UP Cop's Viral Video Touching Maulana's Feet Sparks Political Row; Station In-Charge Transferred
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video purportedly showing Sambhal SHO Inspector Sudhir Panwar touching a Maulana’s feet during a Chehlum procession has gone viral, sparking controversy. Amid protests and allegations of misconduct, Panwar was transferred from Sambhal police station, though police have not linked the move to the v

body.html:
A video purportedly showing the Station House Officer (SHO) of Sambhal police station touching the feet of a Maulana during a Chehlum procession has gone viral on social media, triggering widespread debate and controversy.

The video allegedly shows Inspector Sudhir Panwar bowing before a Maulana seated on a chair inside a house and touching his feet. The Maulana is then seen placing his hand on the officer's head.

The incident reportedly took place on Tuesday during a Chehlum procession in Sambhal, where police personnel had been deployed to maintain law and order.

The viral video surfaced just hours after VHP and Bajrang Dal activists accused the SHO of misbehaving with one of their workers during a protest over the burning of an effigy at Shankar College intersection.

Following the alleged incident, the activists staged a protest outside the police station and recited the Hanuman Chalisa on the premises for around 30 minutes. The protest ended after discussions with the Circle Officer (CO).

Amid the controversy, Superintendent of Police Krishna Kumar Bishnoi transferred Inspector Sudhir Panwar from Sambhal police station and posted him as the SHO of Asmoli Police Station. Inspector Mohit Kumar, who was serving as the Asmoli SHO, has been appointed the new Station House Officer of Sambhal Police Station.

Police have not officially stated whether the transfer was directly linked to the viral video or the protests.
